title: Breadcrumb native coverage audit
scope: B01-B06 only; 8 direct Breadcrumb controls plus the planned Advanced/Visibility behavior.
coverage_policy: Evidence is bounded to the named native records and exact DOM/computed/reload observations. This is representative coverage, not an exhaustive arbitrary-value, font, runtime-control, or motion claim.

cases.purpose: automatic trail on a non-front page
dom_assertions: nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"] > ol; prior item is a[href="index.html"]; current item is span[aria-current=page]
computed_assertions: custom Home base label and Annual community workshops, events and accessibility resources page title survive reload.
cases.reload_devices: Same automatic DOM and no overflow at 1280, 834, and 414px.

dom_assertions: manual source row is class crumb-source with valid href; final row is class crumb-current with span[aria-current=page]; target=_blank adds rel=nofollow sponsored noopener.
cases.reload_devices: Exact manual DOM repeats at 1280, 834, and 414px with no overflow.
limits: The record proves a representative two-row list, not every row count or arbitrary link value.

dom_assertions: data-sep and pseudo separator match chevron/›, slash, dot/·, and dash/—; readable ol text excludes the pseudo separator.
computed_assertions: all four variants report overflow false.
cases.reload_devices: Each of the four variants is recorded at 1280, 834, and 414px.

dom_assertions: responsive records target nav ol/anchor/current text, not the discarded root-nav font probe.
computed_assertions: corrected text probe reads 18px/16px/14px anchor/current/variable sizes at D/T/M
responsive colours are #205080/#304860/#183848 for links and #743522/#603020/#502020 for current page
spacing is 12/10/6 at D/T/M before reset and 12px on all devices after reset
reset colors remain the authored Desktop rgb(32,80,128) and rgb(116,53,34)
cases.reload_devices: Responsive and reset records include 1280, 834, and 414px; overflow false.
limits: Previous root-nav 16px measurement is explicitly rejected as wrong target; ol/anchor probe is authoritative for this record.

dom_assertions: front-page editor helper says no trail; published front-page and zero-row manual outputs have count 0.
cases.reload_devices: Both empty branches are recorded for Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.

dom_assertions: breadcrumb-proof id, qa-breadcrumb class, custom outline, max-width 100%, and visible overflow survive reload; condition non-match yields zero nav/linked crumbs.
computed_assertions: each breakpoint switch produces display:none only at selected width with visible nav at the other two widths.
cases.reload_devices: Visibility and condition matrices cover all three devices; Advanced DOM proof is exact after reload.
limits: Condition controls are behaviorally evidenced but candidate82 accessible-label verification remains pending.
Visibility switches retain DOM while hidden.

pending: candidate82 native verification of enhanced condition combobox labels

scope_gaps: No exhaustive arbitrary values, fonts, row counts, or runtime-generated control enumeration.
Generic Motion/State/Hover/Focus controls are outside B01-B06 proof scope.
No Icon or Quote coverage is claimed by this artifact.
Root-nav font-size probe is excluded because the actual Breadcrumb text is ol/anchor content; corrected probe is retained.
